actions.parse_url.description: Extract the domain, path, and query parameters from a URL.
actions.parse_url.props.returnArrays.des: If checked (recommended), all query parameters are returned as JSON arrays to safely group duplicate keys (e.g., {"tags": ["shoes", "hats"]}). If unchecked, standard web behavior applies, returning only the first value as text.
actions.parse_url.props.url.description: The full URL you want to parse (e.g., https://example.com/page?utm_source=twitter)
actions.send_request.description: Call any URL with a chosen method, optional authentication and body.
actions.send_request.props.body_type.des: How to encode the request body.
actions.send_request.props.followRedirec: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning the response.
actions.send_request.props.headers.descr: Sent with the request as key-value pairs.
actions.send_request.props.method.descri: GET reads data, POST creates it.
actions.send_request.props.queryParams.d: Appended to the URL as a query string.
actions.send_request.props.response_is_b: Return the response as base64, for files like PDFs.
actions.send_request.props.timeout.descr: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.send_request.props.url.descripti: The full URL to call, including https:// or http://
actions.send_request.props.use_proxy.des: Route this request through an HTTP proxy.
description: Send HTTP requests to any URL and use the response in your flow
